site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: AP News 13–15 May confirmed 11 total cases (9 PCR-confirmed Andes virus, 2 suspected) and 3 deaths. Vessel evacuated at Granadilla de Abona with 87 passengers and 35 crew; en route Rotterdam with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse for full disinfection; Arctic schedule uncertain pending health authority clearance.

site.name: GEORGIA
site.desc: Two American Hondius passengers transferred to Emory University Hospital SCDU in Atlanta for monitoring per AP 13 May; CDC chartered a flight to Hartsfield-Jackson for their transport. Two additional Georgia residents asymptomatic and following CDC guidance at home.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: 18 American passengers coordinated to Offutt AFB and transferred to National Quarantine Center at UNMC per AP 13 May; 15 quarantined at NQU including content creator Jake Rosmarin (asymptomatic, 42-day quarantine). One symptomatic individual in UNMC biocontainment; Dr. Stephen Kornfeld cleared and released 14 May after inconclusive swabs resolved negative.

site.name: PERTH / BULLSBROOK / SYDNEY
